    ("r16_trie_llama_ft_scierc", "outputs/r16_trie_llama_ft.jsonl", "ontology_constraints.json", "scierc"),
    ("r16_trie_qwen_ft_scierc", "outputs/r16_trie_qwen_ft.jsonl", "ontology_constraints.json", "scierc"),
]

DOCRED_CONFIGS = [
    ("eval_70b_lora_docred_200_unconstrained", "/root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/r16_70b_lora_docred/docred_200_unconstrained.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w5_qwen_docred_lora_constrained_eval", "outputs/w5_qwen_docred_lora_constrained_eval.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w5_qwen_docred_lora_unconstrained_eval", "outputs/w5_qwen_docred_lora_unconstrained_eval.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w8_qwen_docred_ft_semantic_only", "outputs/w8_qwen_docred_ft_semantic_only.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w8_qwen_docred_ft_grammar_only", "outputs/w8_qwen_docred_ft_grammar_only.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w5_llama_docred_lora_constrained_eval", "outputs/w5_llama_docred_lora_constrained_eval.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w5_llama_docred_lora_unconstrained_eval", "outputs/w5_llama_docred_lora_unconstrained_eval.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w8_llama_docred_ft_semantic_only", "outputs/w8_llama_docred_ft_semantic_only.jsonl", "docred"),
    ("w8_llama_docred_ft_grammar_only", "outputs/w8_llama_docred_ft_grammar_only.jsonl", "docred"),
]

results = {}

# SciERC: use fixed violation_checker.py
print("=== SciERC evaluations (violation_checker.py fixed) ===")
for name, input_path, constraints, dataset in SCIERC_CONFIGS:
    out = f"/tmp/reeval_{name}.json"
    cmd = f"python3 violation_checker.py --input_path {input_path} --constraints_path {constraints} --output_path {out}"
    print(f"\n--- {name} ---")
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"ERROR: {r.stderr}")
        continue
    with open(out) as f:
        report = json.load(f)
    rf1 = report["quality"]["relation_f1"]
    pf = report["summary"]["json_parse_failures"]
    total = report["summary"]["total_documents"]
    results[name] = {
        "R_F1": round(rf1["f1"] * 100, 2),
        "R_P": round(rf1["precision"] * 100, 2),
        "R_R": round(rf1["recall"] * 100, 2),
        "parse_fail_pct": round(pf / total * 100, 2),
    }

# DocRED: use eval_d064.py (already correct, but re-run to verify)
print("\n=== DocRED evaluations (eval_d064.py) ===")
for name, input_path, dataset in DOCRED_CONFIGS:
    out_json = f"/tmp/reeval_{name}.json"
    cmd = f"python3 scripts/eval_d064.py --input_path {input_path} --dataset {dataset} --label {name} --output_json {out_json}"
    print(f"\n--- {name} ---")
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"ERROR: {r.stderr}")
        continue
    with open(out_json) as f:
        report = json.load(f)
    results[name] = {
        "R_F1": report["R_F1"],
        "R_P": report["R_P"],
        "R_R": report["R_R"],
        "parse_fail_pct": report["parse_fail_pct"],
    }

# Print summary
print("\n\n" + "="*80)
print("SUMMARY: Re-evaluation results")
print("="*80)
for name, m in results.items():
    print(f"{name}: R-F1={m['R_F1']}, R-P={m['R_P']}, R-R={m['R_R']}, PF%={m['parse_fail_pct']}")

# Save full results
with open("/tmp/reeval_all_results.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
print("\nFull results saved to /tmp/reeval_all_results.json")
PYEOF
